description: This Java source file defines the `TimeoutInvalidException` class, which is a custom exception used within the Eclipse Ditto project to indicate that a timeout value could not be parsed or is invalid. The class includes static builder methods for constructing instances, handles JSON deserialization, and extends a base exception class with additional context like headers and links.

classes.name: TimeoutInvalidException
classes.description: A custom, immutable runtime exception indicating a timeout value was invalid or could not be parsed. It includes static methods for creating instances and handling JSON deserialization, and it extends `DittoRuntimeException`.

classes.name: TimeoutInvalidException.Builder
classes.description: A thread-unsafe builder class providing a fluent API for constructing `TimeoutInvalidException` instances with custom messages, descriptions, causes, and links.

methods.name: TimeoutInvalidException.newBuilder
methods.description: Creates a new builder instance with default message describing the invalid timeout and maximum timeout boundaries. Accepts timeout durations.

methods.name: TimeoutInvalidException.newBuilder
methods.description: Creates a new builder instance with a specific custom message.

methods.name: TimeoutInvalidException.fromJson
methods.description: Creates a `TimeoutInvalidException` instance from a JSON object and headers, parsing the error message from JSON.

methods.name: setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Returns a new `TimeoutInvalidException` with updated headers, preserving other properties.
